subject: Cryptography evidence for Atlas Payments: KMS/HSM artifacts requested
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@sierra-compliance.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@atlaspayments.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: cryptography evidence for Atlas Payments (SOC 2 / SIG)

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you're well — Atlas Payments is kicking off a follow-up SIG review and their audit team asked us to provide additional cryptography evidence to close a couple of open controls. Can you help with the items below? We need artifacts to support in-transit/at-rest encryption and key lifecycle controls (ideally for the trailing 12 months). Requested deliverables:  

- KMS key rotation logs for customer-facing master keys (CSV or PDF, last 12 months).
- HSM vendor attestation and tamper-evidence report for the cluster used for KMS master keys.
- Key policy for the KMS master key(s) including envelope encryption flow.
- Access matrix showing who can import/export/rotate/revoke keys + evidence of recent access reviews.
- Configuration details showing TLS profiles and any custom cipher suites in use for service-to-service.

If possible, bundle as a single package and provide checksums (SHA256). Atlas is expecting this by 2026-12-08 for their auditor to avoid a control carry-forward. If any of the items need escalation, cc me and the Atlas audit alias.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Auditor | Sierra Compliance
liam.oconnor@sierra-compliance.com

Attachments: SIG_followup_checklist_Atlas_20261130.xlsx (spreadsheet of requested controls)

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@sierra-compliance.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: cryptography evidence for Atlas Payments (SOC 2 / SIG)

Team — tagging you to collect the artifacts Liam requested. Target delivery to Atlas is 2026-12-08; please aim to have a compiled package and drive link by EOD 2026-12-01 so I can review. Specific asks:  

- Dev: (dev_patel) pull KMS rotation logs, export key lifecycle events for the last 12 months, and include a short README describing how logs map to key IDs.
- Marissa: (marissa_cole) pull vendor HSM attestation, any tamper-evidence report, and confirm the HSM firmware version and tamper-seal timestamps.
- Rishi: (rishi_malhotra) export the KMS access matrix and recent access review notes (who approved, dates).
- Laura: help with final packaging + checksum and liaise with Legal if we need to redact any customer-specific PII.

Keep Liam copied on any clarifying Qs. If anything is redacted/partial, call it out in the README so the auditor knows what changed.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
--

Evelyn / all,

Attached are the KMS exports you asked for. Summary below:  

- kms-rotation-logs_2025-11-01_to_2026-11-30.csv — per-key daily events (CREATE, ROTATE, DISABLE, DESTROY) with timestamps and operator principal. Sample row:
  key_id: km-0a1b2c3d, event_type: ROTATE, event_ts: 2026-06-12T03:14:22Z, operator: infra-kms-rotations@redwood.ai, change_ref: JOB-9942
- key_policy_kms_master_key_v3.md — current policy describing envelope encryption, key usage, and CMK rotation cadence (90 days).
- access_matrix_kms_admins_202611.pdf — exported list of principals and assigned roles; includes a summary of last access review (2026-10-28).

Attachments (uploaded to Drive):
- https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AtlasPayments/crypto-evidence-20261130/kms-rotation-logs_2025-11-01_to_2026-11-30.csv
- https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AtlasPayments/crypto-evidence-20261130/key_policy_kms_master_key_v3.md
- https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AtlasPayments/crypto-evidence-20261130/access_matrix_kms_admins_202611.pdf

Notes: rotation is automated via scheduled jobs; manual rotations are flagged in the CSV and cross-referenced to changelist IDs. I redacted principal emails for individual engineers and replaced them with role principals (e.g., infra-kms-ops@redwood.ai) per Legal guidance. If the auditor needs full identity details we should run a controlled disclosure with signed NDA.

Let me know if you need any other exports (audit trail from vault-service, KMS master key policy diff).

- Dev

Attachments: kms-rotation-logs_2025-11-01_to_2026-11-30.csv (CSV), key_policy_kms_master_key_v3.md (MD), access_matrix_kms_admins_202611.pdf (PDF)

Hi Liam / Atlas audit team —

Thanks for the patience. We've compiled the requested cryptography evidence bundle and uploaded it to the shared Drive link below. The package includes:  

- kms-rotation-logs_2025-11-01_to_2026-11-30.csv (CSV)
- hsm-attestation_vendor-safeguard-2026-10-12.pdf (vendor attestation; redacted sections flagged)
- key_policy_kms_master_key_v3.md (current key policy + envelope encryption flow)
- access_matrix_kms_admins_202611.pdf (access matrix + most recent review notes)
- crypto-evidence-bundle_AtlasPayments_20261130.zip (packaged bundle, SHA256: 3a7f1b...)

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AtlasPayments/crypto-evidence-20261130
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/deals/HS-4721

Notes and caveats:
- We redacted individual engineer emails and replaced them with role principals where required by our internal privacy policy. The access matrix includes approver names and dates; if the auditor needs unredacted identities we can provide them after a data-sharing agreement is executed.
- The HSM attestation is vendor-signed; tamper-evidence timestamps are included in the PDF. Any questions about firmware versions or tamper logs, please let us know and I will loop in Marissa and the vendor.

If this satisfies the request, please confirm and we'll close the SIG action item on our side. If Atlas wants additional artifact formats or a signed chain-of-custody for the HSM material, tell us what they need and we will coordinate.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
